 Summary
 Wales host Portugal at Cardiff City Stadium in group A4 of the Nations League
 Watch/listen live via buttons on this page
 Wales will finish bottom of their group but face a play-off in March to preserve their League A status
 A draw or a victory for Portugal - who have secured a spot in the quarter-finals - will ensure Jorge Jesus' men win the group
 Manchester United's Bruno Fernandes puts away side ahead with stunning strike on 11 minutes
 David Brooks delivers instant response for Wales to make it 1-1 as Sorba Thomas puts home side ahead 
 Pedro Neto volley brings Portugal level before half time

 Most recent Most popular GOAL - Wales 2-2 Portugal published at 43 mins 43 mins 
 Pedro Neto 
 This time it is Wales' lead which does not last long.
 Portugal make ground down the left and Pedro Neto arrives at the far post to turn the ball home from close range.

 Post published at 20:27 GMT 20:27 GMT 
 Wales 2-1 Portugal

Former Wales international on BBC MOTD Wales 
 It comes for nothing from Wales and that touch across leads to a tidy little finish from Thomas as he takes it the wrong side of Pedro Neto. 
 We have heard Craig Bellamy talk the talk, and Sorba Thomas is helping him walk the walk.

Former Wales striker on BBC Radio Wales 
 That is fantastic from Sorba Thomas.
 He gets across Pedro Neto and slots it into the bottom corner.
 What a brilliant response from Wales to going a goal down.

 Wales 2-1 Portugal

 The touch across the defender is what makes this goal from Sorba.
 Often he's looking to provide for others but his manager's told him to be more selfish.

 GOAL - Wales 2-1 Portugal published at 40 mins 40 mins 
 Sorba Thomas 
 Image source, Getty Images Wales are in front - and it is some goal! 
 Danny Ward starts the move, with Jay Dasilva and Harry Wilson having touches before David Brooks' touch sends Sorba Thomas surging forward once more.
 This time he drives into the box before rolling a shot inside the far post.

Former Wales international on BBC MOTD Wales

BBC Radio Wales commentator 
 This is the first time Portugal have come to this part of the world for 75 years.
 Goals from Mal Griffiths and Trevor Ford gave Wales their only victory against them over the road at Ninian Park in May 1951.

BBC Sport Wales at the Cardiff City Stadium

Former Wales striker on BBC Radio Cymru 
 That's how to play through pressure, and good pressure.
 We were confident and brave, it's a great move. Under such pressure, we opened Portugal up.
